info.title: zigbee-bridge MQTT API
info.description:
Everything zigbee-bridge publishes and accepts on MQTT.

Topics here use the default base topic, `zigbee` (`mqtt.base_topic` in the configuration), and Home Assistant's default discovery prefix, `homeassistant` (`homeassistant.discovery_prefix`). `{device}` is the name a person gave a device, or its IEEE address as `0x00124b0001020304`.

The bridge publishes and subscribes at QoS 1. Payloads are JSON unless a message says otherwise. Requests go to `zigbee/bridge/request/<name>`; the answer comes on `zigbee/bridge/response/<name>`, echoing the request's `transaction` so a client can match the two. Network keys never appear on MQTT.

broker.description: Your MQTT broker: `mqtt.host` and `mqtt.port` in the configuration. The bridge connects with a clean session, its `mqtt.client_id`, and `zigbee/bridge/state` set to offline as its last will.

DiscoveryConfig.name: DiscoveryConfig
DiscoveryConfig.title: DiscoveryConfig
DiscoveryConfig.summary: A Home Assistant entity for one of a device's readings

object_id.description: The entity id Home Assistant derives: `<device>_<field>`.

value_template.description: Picks the reading out of the state.

schema.description: `json` for lights: state and commands are JSON.

command_topic.description: The device's `/set` topic, for lights and switches.

payload_on.description:
Binary sensors: the value that means on. Switches: the command that
turns it on.

payload_off.description:
Binary sensors: the value that means off. Switches: the command that
turns it off.

state_on.description: Switches: the state that means on.

state_off.description: Switches: the state that means off.

payload.description:
A Home Assistant MQTT discovery config, retained on
`<discovery_prefix>/<component>/<ieee>/<field>/config`: one entity per
reading, light or switch. An empty retained message removes the entity.
Keys are Home Assistant's; see its MQTT integration documentation.

state.description:
`ON`, `OFF` or `TOGGLE`, in any case. `ON` together with

How long a `brightness` or `color_temp` change takes, in seconds, to a
tenth.

payload.description: A command for a device, on `<device>/set`. Any combination of keys.

time.description:
